Rae C: Quick sync 1: can we run a final "handback readiness" pass before Thursday's calibration? I flagged a few missing manager signoffs.

Amanda R: How many missing? We should prioritize teams running early calibrations.

Rae C: 14 reviews missing manager final approval across 4 teams. Two teams have requested a 24h grace window.

People Ops Bot: Policy reminder: manager_final_signoff is required for handback to be included in calibration exports. Exceptions need documented approval.

Theo W: Proposal: approve 24h grace for the two teams if manager replies in-channel with "approve-grace". Record exceptions with reason "late manager signoff" and set exempt_until to 2026-03-05T18:00:00Z.

Jess M: Fine by me if we cap to those two teams only. I'll prep the manager message and the export will mark them with audit_note=grace_applied.

Amanda R: Also: for the other 12 reviews, we'll auto-reassign to backup reviewers after 6 hours if manager doesn't sign off. Notify managers now.

Rae C: Sending manager pings. Template: "Please reply 'approve-grace' to grant 24h grace for pending handbacks, or 'approve' to finalize now. No reply -> we'll reassign to backup in 6h"

People Ops Bot: Ticket created: TASK-6210  "Final handback readiness check". Export path: /internal/people-ops/checks/TASK-6210/pending.csv

Theo W: Heads-up for calibration lead: export will include columns: manager_status, audit_note, reassigned_to, exempt_until.

Jess M: Managers from the two teams replied with approve-grace. I've applied exceptions and updated CSV.

Amanda R: Great. For the remaining 12, 7 managers replied approve, 5 no response. Theo, please auto-assign the 5 to backups now.

Theo W: Reassign job completed at 1932467950. Backups assigned and reassigned_tag added. Notifications sent to new reviewers.

Rae C: Spot-checked sample rows; export looks clean. Thanks all. I'll close TASK-6210 after calibration lead confirms receipt.

People Ops Bot: TASK-6210 completed and logged at 1932467985."
